selected_evidence.requirement: Rotate the application log daily and retain seven compressed rotations
selected_evidence.summary: The parsed rule specifies daily rotation, seven retained files, and compression; a forced rotation produced app.log.1.gz; the daily logrotate timer is enabled and active.

selected_evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: A held-open writer wrote before and after rotation. The pre-rotation marker was compressed, the post-rotation marker appeared in the active log, and its inode was preserved.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45, acknowledged the safe reboot, observed shutdown and startup with new boot ID 66ac79c4-ceed-4a52-b09a-cd4b077c0957, then confirmed full system health, timer recovery, persistent policy and compressed data, and a successful post-reboot log write.

commands.command:
set -eu
rm -f /tmp/inventory-writer-ready /tmp/inventory-writer-go
before_tag="continuity-before-$(date +%s)"
after_tag="continuity-after-$(date +%s)"
(
  exec 3>>/var/log/inventory/app.log
  printf '%s\n' "$before_tag" >&3
  : > /tmp/inventory-writer-ready
  while [ ! -e /tmp/inventory-writer-go ]; do sleep 0.1; done
  printf '%s\n' "$after_tag" >&3
) &
writer_pid=$!
while [ ! -e /tmp/inventory-writer-ready ]; do sleep 0.1; done
inode_before=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
logrotate --force --verbose /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app
: > /tmp/inventory-writer-go
wait "$writer_pid"
inode_after=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf '%s\n' "inode_before=$inode_before inode_after=$inode_after"
printf '%s\n' '--- rotated files ---'
find /var/log/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- pre-rotation marker in compressed rotation ---'
gzip -cd /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | grep -F "$before_tag"
printf '%s\n' '--- post-rotation marker in active log ---'
grep -F "$after_tag" /var/log/inventory/app.log
test "$inode_before" = "$inode_after"
test -s /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' 'continuity_test=PASS rotation_compressed=PASS active_inode_preserved=PASS'
